records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to three Wrenfield emails (email:d9734616, email:8b2b7757, email:c2ae3d80). No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance of self-start, but silence dominates.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

I know a new tool can sit untouched during a busy stretch, so no worries if Wrenfield hasn't had your attention yet. Whenever you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is the quickest way to see how it fits your work. When you want company on that, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Nadia
